description: Returns whether precedents and standards are working for this account: precedent accuracy from spot checks, share of decisions answered by precedent, decisions right the first time, standards false alarms, and the time and cost of a decision. Each number comes with how many decisions it rests on; one marked early is a hint, not a fact. Also shows the precedent settings and any change Plures is suggesting. Read only: a person changes settings and answers suggestions in the dashboard. Free.
